value.rationale: The natural Poisson-reset MFPT asymptotic leaves unknown the robustness of complete time/exit-side statistics to clock laws and the infinite-mean clock boundary. This theorem classifies integrable, critical and subcritical power-tail regimes, identifies a universal exponential joint law precisely through the critical logarithmic case, and supplies an explicit nonuniversal marked transform and moment coefficient below the boundary. The Cauchy coefficient gap confirms a substantive dynamical transition rather than a normalization exercise.
